title_en: Rebuttal to the Theory of Proving Limits for Almighty God (Part 2)
description_en: Rebuttal to the theory of proving limits for Almighty God, Part (2). The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: Part two of the scholarly refutation against attributing physical boundaries and limits to God.
